definitions.gloss: to perform music; to play an instrument; to give a musical performance
definitions.explanation: To play a musical instrument or perform music, especially in a somewhat formal or public context. Covers both solo and ensemble performances.

examples.japanese: ピアノを{演奏|えんそう}する。
オーケストラが{美|うつく}しい{曲|きょく}を{演奏|えんそう}した。
examples.english: The orchestra performed a beautiful piece.

examples.japanese: {学園祭|がくえんさい}でバンドの{演奏|えんそう}を{披露|ひろう}することになった。
examples.english: We're going to showcase our band performance at the school festival.

notes:
Composed of {演|えん} (perform) + {奏|そう} (play music). Takes を for the instrument or piece: ピアノを{演奏|えんそう}する. The noun form {演奏|えんそう} is extremely common in music contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {生演奏|なまえんそう}: live performance
- {独奏|どくそう}: solo performance
- {合奏|がっそう}: ensemble, group performance
- {演奏会|えんそうかい}: concert, recital
- {演奏者|えんそうしゃ}: performer, musician

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {弾|ひ}く: to play (piano, guitar, strings) — casual, everyday word
- {吹|ふ}く: to play (wind instruments) — specifically for blowing instruments
- {叩|たた}く: to play (drums, percussion) — specifically for striking
- {演奏|えんそう}する: more formal, encompasses all instruments and performance contexts
